name: nysa
description:
Nysa turns your team's meetings, email, and calendar into one shared brain, so ChatGPT knows what your team knows, not just what you paste in. Ask what was decided in a meeting you missed, get briefed before a call with context from teammates' conversations, or look up anyone your team works with. ChatGPT can search captured meetings and read their transcripts, look up people and companies, search the facts Nysa has drawn from your team's work, each with its source, and check your own calendar.

Every request runs under your own Nysa sign-in, so ChatGPT sees only what your account can already see, and access is checked on every call. Raw email stays private to its owner; the team sees only the facts drawn from it. Your calendar stays private to you.

defaultPrompt: What did we decide in our last planning meeting, and who owns the follow-ups?
Brief me for my next meeting with Acme: who's attending and what have we discussed with them before?
What have customers told us about SSO, and who on the team heard it?

positive.description: Look up a customer contact and what the team knows about them.
positive.prompt: Who is our contact at Acme Robotics, and what do we know about them?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves Acme Robotics and Laura Vega. Returns sourced facts: Laura Vega is Head of Operations and main pilot contact, decides on expanding the pilot, and asked for the weekly report in Spanish.

positive.description: Summarize recent customer feedback and who heard it.
positive.prompt: What have customers told us recently, and who on the team heard it?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists sourced feedback from Laura Vega (Acme Robotics), Priya Nair (Globex Foods) and Tom Becker (Initech Retail), and names Sam Ortiz where he heard it. Does not invent feedback.

positive.description: Recall a deal agreement with pricing, deadlines, owners and open items.
positive.prompt: What did we agree with Acme Robotics on the pilot, including price, deadlines and owners, and what is still open?
positive.expected_behavior: States the 90-day pilot from October 1, 2026 at $4,000 per month, expansion if pick accuracy is above 98% by December 15, Sam Ortiz sends the report by December 10, and the open SSO item, each with its source.

positive.description: Save a new fact about a person and company to the company Brain.
positive.prompt: I met Ana Ruiz today, she is CFO at Contoso Health (contoso-health.example).
positive.expected_behavior: Calls remember with Ana Ruiz (person) and Contoso Health (company, contoso-health.example) as subjects and confirms the note was saved.

positive.description: Save a private idea and find it later in personal notes.
positive.prompt: Save this just for me: offer Acme Robotics a 10% loyalty discount if they expand. Then show what my notes say about the loyalty discount.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves the idea as a private note (not company facts), then search_my_notes returns the loyalty discount note to this user only.

negative.description: Creating calendar events is out of scope; Nysa only reads the calendar.
negative.prompt: Schedule a 30-minute call with Laura Vega next Tuesday at 3pm.

negative.description: Sending email is out of scope; Nysa never sends messages.
negative.prompt: Email Acme Robotics to confirm we accept the renewal terms.

negative.description: Public web news is out of scope; Nysa answers only from the team’s own meetings, email, and calendar.
negative.prompt: What is the latest public news about OpenAI’s funding?

publication.release_notes: First release of Nysa for ChatGPT.
